notes.title: The cherry on top
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809687/73ec081407edb6e49054afeb635e728f2c3af61f.png[/img]

We've been working hard on getting "Feeling Square?" done. We only have a few more things to cross off our list, so we can finally release the game. This has been one intense time; with a new release date, and a bunch of new content we are at a point where we are ready to throw the game into the world.

We are so exited to see all of you amazing people play the game, and see those rage moments you'll get from it. 



[previewyoutube=Psg5XpFciE4;full][/previewyoutube]


- SquareBoxTeam
